note.text: Addition connectives link information without necessarily showing a cause or contrast. And joins similar grammatical units. Also commonly adds a point within a clause. Moreover and furthermore can add a further point between clauses or sentences. As well as adds related information, but its structure is not always interchangeable with and. Keep parallel forms and suitable punctuation. A word such as because introduces a reason, not merely an additional point.

sections.heading: Understand the ideas
sections.text: Addition connectives link information without necessarily showing a cause or contrast. And joins similar grammatical units. Also commonly adds a point within a clause. Moreover and furthermore can add a further point between clauses or sentences. As well as adds related information, but its structure is not always interchangeable with and. Keep parallel forms and suitable punctuation. A word such as because introduces a reason, not merely an additional point.

sections.heading: Apply the ideas locally
sections.text: The school club reads stories and discusses them. It also keeps a reading journal. Moreover, members help younger pupils choose books. Each sentence adds information about the club. Replacing moreover with therefore would claim a result relationship that the writer has not established.

sections.heading: Reason and check
sections.text: Ask what relationship the writer intends. Link words to words and clauses to clauses without creating fragments. Do not use a comma alone to join full sentences simply because an addition adverb appears. Read the result aloud with a partner if possible; the written task checks structure, not pronunciation.
